name: Qwen-Edit_Anime2Real
description: Anime2Real is a Qwen-Edit Lora designed to convert anime characters into realistic styles. The current version is beta, with characters appearing somewhat greasy. The Lora strength must be set to <1. You may click the link below to test the LoRa effect: Anime2Real V1.0 Update: This version makes characters appear less greasy and significantly more natural. The default generation produces Western facial features; to generate Asian or other facial types, simply load an additional Realistic Series LORA.
